title: Edge Detect
description: An edge-detection filter for a live source, run as a GPU shader. Choose Sobel, Scharr, Prewitt or Laplacian kernels, then thicken, threshold and soften the lines. Render them as white-on-black, ink on paper, neon in the source's own colours, a glowing overlay on the image, or hue-coded by edge direction. Strength is audio-mappable. Works on the camera, a dropped clip, the demo, or the layers below in the Mixer/Patch.
